exec $CLI -input run.json -slice 1s
stdout '"schema_version":1'
stdout '"completed_attempts":0'
stdout '"duration":2'
! exec $CLI -input run.json -slice 0s
stderr 'slice width must be positive'
! exec $CLI -input invalid.json
stderr 'invalid run accounting or schema'
! exec $CLI
stderr 'usage: llm-report'
-- run.json --
{"schema_version":1,"started_at":1000,"finished_at":3000,"duration":2,"attempts":0,"successes":0,"failures":0,"records":[]}
